subject: Next steps: security discovery & pen-test handoff for Helix Health (timeline + SLA)
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: emma.carter@helixhealth.com, security_ops@helixhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, pen test & vuln process (Helix)

Hi Emma — great talking earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can scope the pen test & vuln disclosure process and get you a mutual action plan (MAP):

1) SOC 2 + compliance status: can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC2 summary? Also any specific HIPAA / GDPR controls or DPO contact if applicable.

2) Pen test: we typically request a technical pen-test report (handback) or at minimum a scope and expected delivery timeframe. Please confirm whether you have an internal report we can review or if you prefer we coordinate with your 3rd-party assessor.

3) Vulnerability disclosure & SLA expectations: our standard ask is a 72-hour initial acknowledgement for critical findings, 7 days for high, 30 days for medium. If you have an alternate cadence or legal constraints, flag them.

4) NDA / procurement: if there's an NDA or PO requirement for sharing report artifacts, please point us to the DocuSign/Procurement contact.

Next steps: if you can attach the SOC2 summary and the current pen-test scope (or point of contact), we will draft a MAP and proposed SLA matrix and share a DocuSign NDA link as needed.

Thanks — copying Marissa and Sergio to help coordinate the MAP and timeline.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: (none)

Subject: Re: Security discovery: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, pen test & vuln process (Helix)

Laura — thanks for the call and the clear list. Attaching the SOC2 summary and our current pen-test scope (redacted). A couple of quick notes:

- We have a recent SOC 2 Type II report (Q4 2026); internal legal prefers to share the full report under NDA, so I attached a one-page summary for now.
- Our pen-test was last performed in Nov 2026 by Securify (3rd party). We have a draft scope attached; the full technical report will be shared post-NDA.
- For vulnerability response, our security ops prefers: ack within 48 hours for critical, patch window 14 days for critical unless compensated by compensating controls. We are open to negotiating a faster SLA for critical items in contract.

Attachments: Helix_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Helix_Pentest_Scope.xlsx

Emma Carter
Director, Product Security
Helix Health

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Helix — SOC2 + pen test scope received; proposed MAP & SLA

Thanks — saw Emma's attachments. Drafting a concise MAP to keep procurement and security aligned. Proposed items below for internal review before I send to Helix: 

- Proposed timeline:
  • MAP draft to customer: 2027-04-15 (tomorrow)
  • NDA executed: target by 2027-04-20
  • Full pen-test report handback (if performed by Helix vendor): within 7 business days of NDA execution; otherwise coordinate review window with vendor (we should get vendor contact).

- Proposed SLA (negotiation starting point):
  • Critical: acknowledge within 24 hours; investigate + mitigation plan within 72 hours; full remediation or compensating controls within 7 calendar days where feasible.
  • High: acknowledge within 48 hours; remediation plan within 14 days.
  • Medium/Low: standard 30-90 day cadence depending on risk and business constraints.

- Scanning cadence recommendation:
  • Authenticated weekly vulnerability scans for infra components in-scope, monthly for app-level authenticated scans, and quarterly external network scans.

- Disclosure process:
  • Redacted public disclosure only after coordinated sign-off. Private handback to Redwood (technical report) under NDA. We will offer a 72-hour embargo post-delivery for customer coordination.

Action items for Laura/Sergio: please confirm the SLA tolerances above and whether we should accept Helix's initial ask (48-hr irq ack / 14-day patch) or push for the tighter 24/72/7 matrix. I can fold this into the MAP and send to Emma with the DocuSign NDA link and our expected timelines.

Attaching: Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (draft)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: emma.carter@helixhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: security discovery & pen-test handoff for Helix Health (timeline + SLA)

Emma — thanks for the SOC2 summary and scope. Marissa and I reviewed and proposed a MAP that tightens the critical path slightly to align with typical SaaS customers handling PHI. Key points:

- We propose the SLA matrix Marissa drafted (Critical: 24/72/7; High: 48/14; Medium: 30). We understand Helix suggested 48/14 for critical; we're happy to be flexible in contract language but would like a committed accelerated response for critical findings given potential PHI exposure.

- NDA: sharing the full SOC2 report and the full technical pen-test will require a simple NDA. Please sign via this DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-helix-nda. Target for NDA completion: 2027-04-20.

- Vendor coordination: please provide the 3rd-party assessor contact (Securify rep) or confirm if you want Redwood to engage directly. If Securify will share the report post-NDA, we will accept the vendor channel handback.

- Delivery expectation: once NDA is executed, we expect the technical report handback within 7 business days or a firm vendor-provided delivery date. If Helix cannot provide the technical report, we can scope a Redwood-led follow-up assessment and provide timelines and pricing.

Please confirm acceptance or flag items by EOD Monday so we can finalize the MAP and route the NDA to procurement.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachments: NDA_Helix_Redwood.pdf
